select c.collection_id as collectionId, c.sale_id as saleId, c.dept_id as deptId, c.collection_status as collectionStatus, c.promised_pay_date as promisedPayDate, c.last_follow_time as lastFollowTime, c.age_days as ageDays, c.unpaid_amount as unpaidAmount, c.member_id as memberId, coalesce(miss.missCount, 0) as historyMissCount from finance_receivable_collection c left join ( select sale_id, count(1) as missCount from finance_receivable_collection where collection_status = 'PROMISED' and promised_pay_date is not null and promised_pay_date < curdate() group by sale_id ) miss on miss.sale_id = c.sale_id where c.del_flag = '0' and c.collection_status in ('PENDING', 'PROMISED')
order by c.unpaid_amount desc limit 50

select p.dept_id as deptId, p.product_id as productId, p.quantity as currentQuantity, coalesce(out.recentOutbound, 0) as recentOutbound, coalesce(snap.snapshotDate, '1970-01-01') as snapshotDate, case when exists ( select 1 from fin_stock_snapshot s where s.dept_id = p.dept_id and s.product_id = p.product_id and s.snapshot_date = curdate() and s.quantity != p.quantity ) then 1 else 0 end as snapshotMismatch from fin_stock_position p left join ( select dept_id, product_id, sum(abs(after_quantity - before_quantity)) as recentOutbound from fin_stock_ledger where del_flag = '0' and biz_type = 'OUTBOUND' and ledger_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day) group by dept_id, product_id ) out on out.dept_id = p.dept_id and out.product_id = p.product_id left join ( select dept_id, product_id, max(snapshot_date) as snapshotDate from fin_stock_snapshot group by dept_id, product_id ) snap on snap.dept_id = p.dept_id and snap.product_id = p.product_id where p.quantity != 0 or exists ( select 1 from fin_stock_ledger l where l.dept_id = p.dept_id and l.product_id = p.product_id and l.del_flag = '0' and l.after_quantity < 0 )
limit 50
mapper.insert: insert into finance_prediction_sample (tenant_id, dept_id, prediction_type, source_id, sample_date, window_days, score, level, forecast_amount, actual_amount, deviation_amount, deviation_rate, basis, create_by, create_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{predictionType}, #{sourceId}, #{sampleDate}, #{windowDays}, #{score}, #{level}, #{forecastAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{deviationAmount}, #{deviationRate}, #{basis}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})

insert into finance_prediction_factor (sample_id, factor_code, factor_name, factor_value, factor_weight, explanation, create_time) values (#{sampleId}, #{factorCode}, #{factorName}, #{factorValue}, #{factorWeight}, #{explanation}, #{createTime})

insert into finance_what_if_simulation (tenant_id, dept_id, simulation_date, base_pressure_score, simulated_pressure_score, delta_score, input_json, result_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{simulationDate}, #{basePressureScore}, #{simulatedPressureScore}, #{deltaScore}, #{inputJson}, #{resultJson}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
